title: Heated Rivalry
author: Rachel Reid
summary: Two star players from rival professional hockey teams begin a secret relationship that grows over the years. Both must weigh their love against the fear of how the sport will treat them.
readIf: you like sports romance with a long, slow emotional arc and a lot of heat.
skipIf: you want a story with a plot outside the central couple, because this one focuses on them.

pairings.reason: Another hockey romance in which a rivalry on the ice turns into something warmer.
Another story of rivals in the public eye who fall in love and risk everything to keep it.
A classic rivals-to-lovers romance with bantering colleagues rather than rival athletes.
